title: Protocol for density gradient neutrophil isolation and flow cytometry-based characterization from human peripheral blood
protocol: Add 10 mL 75% Percoll into a 50 mL Conical tube using sterile serological pipette.
Carefully overlay 10 mL 62% Percoll on top of 75% Percoll using sterile serological pipette.
Dilute 10 mL fresh blood 1:1 in 10 mL of serum-free RPMI 1640 without antibiotics.
Carefully overlay 20 mL of diluted blood on top of the 62% Percoll using a sterile serological pipette in a dropwise manner.
Draw blood from the donor.
Dilute drawn blood in RPMI 1640 medium according to volume guidelines.
Layer diluted blood over two Percoll layers (75% and 62%) in a conical tube.
Centrifuge the conical tubes at 200 × g for 25 minutes.
Centrifuge the conical tubes at 400 × g for 15 minutes.
Remove tubes gently after centrifugation to avoid disrupting the gradient.
Layer peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) on top of the 62% Percoll layers.
Collect neutrophils positioned between the 75% and 62% Percoll layers using sterile transfer pipettes or micropipettes.
Transfer collected neutrophils to a new 50 mL Conical tube.
Add RPMI 1640 to the tube up to a volume of 50 ml.
Wash neutrophils by centrifuging at 300 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant completely and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of neutrophil buffer.
Add 10 μl of cell suspension to a disposable hemocytometer and count the cell number under the microscope.
Place cytospin filter paper on top of the microscope slide.
Place the cytofunnel on top of the filter paper, ensuring holes are aligned.
Place the slide, filter paper, and cytofunnel into the cytoclip with cardboard filters facing the center of the cytospin.
Aliquot 1.0–2.0 × 10^5 neutrophils in a volume of 100 μL into the well of the cytoclip set.
Carefully place the cytofunnel into the well of the cytocentrifuge setup.
Place the cytoclip containing the prepared sample into the cytocentrifuge.
Spin the cytocentrifuge at 800 × g for 5 minutes at 20–25°C.
Remove the filters from the slides after centrifugation with minimal physical contact.
Examine each slide under a microscope to ensure cells have attached well to the slide.
Air dry the slide at 20–25°C for 20 minutes.
Stain the slide with May Grünwald stain solution for 5 minutes at 20–25°C.
Transfer the stained slide to 1× PBS for 1.5 minutes.
Stain the slide with diluted Giemsa stain solution (1:20 with Ultrapure H2O) for 20 minutes at 20–25°C.
Wash the slide under running Ultrapure H2O until clean.
Air dry the stained slide at 20–25°C.
Mount the slide by adding one drop of VectaMount mounting medium to the center of the cells and then placing a coverslip on top.
Add 0.5–1 × 10^6 neutrophils in 100 μL neutrophil buffer per well in a 96-well U-bottom plate or per tube in round-bottom polystyrene tubes.
Centrifuge the plate (with lid on) or tubes at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μL FACS buffer + Fc Block (diluted 1:100 in FACS buffer) for 20 min on ice or at 4°C.
Centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μL of FACS buffer per well.
Resuspend unstained control in 100 μL FACS buffer per well.
Titrate each antibody by adding 5 μL, 2 μL or 1 μL of the respective antibodies to 100 μL FACS buffer per well.
Mix each well by pipetting up and down using a multichannel micropipette.
Wrap the plate in foil to protect from light and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Following incubation, centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells with 200 μL FACS buffer as a wash step.
Centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Analyze acquired data using flow cytometry data analysis software of choice.
Add 0.5–1 × 10^6 neutrophils in 100 μL neutrophil buffer per well into the appropriate wells of a 96-well U-bottom plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Centrifuge plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL FACS buffer + Fc Block diluted 1:100 in FACS buffer.
Incubate for 20 min on ice or at 4°C.
Centrifuge plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend unstained control in 100 μL FACS buffer per well.
Stain the cells with appropriate volume of antibodies based on titration.
Prepare FMO controls by staining the cells with all antibodies except one.
Mix each well by pipetting up and down using a multichannel micropipette.
Wrap plate in foil to protect from light.
Incubate wrapped plate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Centrifuge plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Prepare unstained and single-stained controls for every fluorophore used in the panel.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer per well to a 96-well-U bottom plate or per tube in round-bottom polystyrene tubes.
Add one drop of compensation beads to each well containing FACS buffer.
Vortex the beads for 1 minute prior to use.
Add 1 μL of the antibody to respective wells except the unstained control.
Wrap plate in foil to protect from light and incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Following incubation, centrifuge plate at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend beads in 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Run the unstained and single-stained beads to set appropriate PMT voltage.
Generate compensation matrix using single-stained beads.
Acquire samples.
